name: evals
description: LLM evaluation methodology and eval-suite design, distilled from Anthropic's official evaluation guidance — a knowledge router over success criteria, eval design, and grading methods (/evals:methodology), plus an action skill that interviews for measurable success criteria and scaffolds a graded eval suite for an LLM app or a Claude Code skill (/evals:design). Guidance and scaffolding only: no command executes model-graded evals.
